test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: When was the Food Corporation of India (FCI) set up under the Food Corporations Act, 1964 with the primary duty to purchase, store, move/transport, distribute and sell food grains and other foodstuffs?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1965.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Food Corporation of India(FCI) was set up in the year **1965** under the Food Corporation Act.
 
• It was established because of the backdrop of the major Shortage of grain. 
 
• The primary duty of FCI has to undertake purchase, store, move/transport, distribute and sell food grains and other food items.
 
• The Major Objective of **Food Policy: ****Effective price support operations for safeguarding the interests of the farmers**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Food Corporation **Act is used to provide for the establishment of Food Corporations **for the purpose of trading in food grain**
 
• Food Corporation is established under the ownership of the **Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India.**
 
• **Purpose of Food Corporation of India:**__
 
 
• ​**P****urchase.**
 
• **Storage.**
 
• **Movement transport.**
 
• **Distribution and sale of food grains and another foodstuff**.
